reviews.title: Thermalright is my choice every time.
reviews.comment: 1 year in with 9 of these running for hours daily. Absolutely no issues. The price is beyond great, they're great with airflow and noise level, the individually addressed LED's look so nice (crazy good at this price point). They are clearly made well because I've put them through far too many hours in a years time when far more expensive brands have failed on me. I've said it before, thermalright is very, very impressive.
reviews.author: K Pel

reviews.title: Great quality
reviews.comment: I picked up the Thermalright TL-C12CW-S X3 120mm White ARGB case fans and they’ve been a solid addition to my build—quiet operation, smooth airflow, and the ARGB lighting looks clean and vibrant without being overwhelming. The white finish matches perfectly with my case aesthetic, and installation was straightforward with good quality cables. Overall, they deliver both cooling performance and style, making them a great value for anyone looking to upgrade their setup.
reviews.author: Benjaman Adams

reviews.title: relatively cheap, look nice, and perform as expected
reviews.comment: I bought these for a PC build I was working on. I set all 3 in the front of the case for positive air pressure. They feel and look to be high quality. The RGB is appealing to look at, especially in the dark. They perform as expected and produce good airflow, keeping components inside the case cool. Only problem I had was that one screw was stripped, but I just used 3 and it holds fine. They can be daisy chained together and the cables are long, making cable management easy. If I wanted more RGB fans, I would certainly buy this again.
reviews.author: bart

reviews.title: Good fans.
reviews.comment: Quality fans at a great price. I started buying these fans a few months ago when my sons build needed a new fan. I was very impressed and when it came time to build my new machine I ordered these. The noise level is good and they seem to push airflow. I use to only by the beQuiet brand and though I have no issues with that brand I feel like the value is better with these.
reviews.author: K McC

reviews.title: Great Value Case Fan Replacements
reviews.comment: Not perfect, but WAY better than the stock fans that were in my case. So quiet versus the noise the original case fans produced.
